source.citation: Shi, Wong, Huang, Wong & Kaminer, Transverse recoil imprinted on free-electron radiation, Nat. Commun. 15, 7803 (2024), Fig. 2b/d/f

conventions.geometry: straight 30 nm Si film, beam along [001], photon in x-z plane at theta = 100 deg
conventions.units: E_eV photon energy [eV]; y, peak photons/(eV sr electron); area_per_sr photons/(sr electron) over the stored E range
conventions.reflection: paper label n_z with g = n 2 pi/a; PyRITE rows (h,k,|n_z|) are the negation
conventions.curves: CL = paper's classical Eq. (1); QM = paper's Eq. (3). n_z=-2 sits in the left half, n_z=-3 in the right; 30 keV shares one x axis, split at 1.45 keV
conventions.axes: n_z=-2 is read on the left y axis and n_z=-3 on the right axis (panels d, f carry different scales). The right-axis reading of d/f n_z=-3 is ambiguous: an independent model of the paper's own inputs matches the n_z=-3 QM heights read on the left axis (#1103). QM/CL area ratios within one n_z group are axis-independent.
conventions.uncertainty: peaks and positions reproduce manual reads within 3 %; areas depend on the stored E window and on dotted-stroke interpolation
